items.what: Taps on the Call, Text, Book a time, Let's talk and Get directions buttons: which button was tapped and where on the page, never who tapped it. Call and Text never send the phone number; Book a time and Get directions send the link address.
items.where: Passed to Optima Analytics on the page
items.when: only when Optima Analytics is on

notes: The call bar stores nothing and sets no cookies. Call and Text open the visitor's own phone app; Get directions opens Google Maps in a new tab, where Google's own privacy policy applies.
